verdict.rationale: Buzz has no documented recap or summary feature. Its agents can be @mentioned in channels and reply (buzz-docs-10, buzz-supp-acp-harness), and they can search months of history and surface the relevant threads (buzz-gh-3), so a user could plausibly ask an agent to catch them up; a 'personalized feed' is also listed (buzz-docs-14). missing for 10: an explicit, documented AI summary or recap feature for missed channels and threads, any unread or catch-up digest, and hands-on or independent corroboration that agent-produced recaps work.
